ImageDropHost.InitializeFailed.zh: 无法初始化图片拖入接收（{0}）。
ImageDropHost.InitializeFailed.en: Could not initialize image drop reception ({0}).

ImageDropHost.InvalidRegistration.zh: 拖入目标窗口无效，或已被注册。
ImageDropHost.InvalidRegistration.en: The drop target window is invalid or already registered.

ImageDropHost.RegisterFailed.zh: 无法注册图片拖入目标（{0}）。
ImageDropHost.RegisterFailed.en: Could not register the image drop target ({0}).

ImageDropHost.RevokeFailed.zh: 无法解除图片拖入目标注册（{0}）。
ImageDropHost.RevokeFailed.en: Could not revoke the image drop target ({0}).

ImageDropHost.RequiresSta.zh: 图片拖入需要在浮绘的 STA 界面线程中启用。
ImageDropHost.RequiresSta.en: Image drops must be enabled on FloatCanvas's STA interface thread.

ImageDropHost.Unavailable.zh: 当前状态下无法接收图片拖入。
ImageDropHost.Unavailable.en: Image drop reception is unavailable in the current state.

ImageDropHost.ShowFailed.zh: 无法显示图片拖入接收层。
ImageDropHost.ShowFailed.en: Could not show the image drop reception surface.
